text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness. To understand your condition better, how many days postpartum are you, and have you experienced any vaginal discharge, foul-smelling lochia, or uterine pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum endometritis with urinary retention.

The patient's history of a prolonged labor, uterine tenderness, and decreased bowel sounds is highly suggestive of postpartum endometritis, while the increased frequency of urination indicates a possible urinary retention or cystitis. I will need to confirm these findings with a pelvic exam and a bladder scan to assess for a distended bladder.
